simple.meaning: זֵרוּעַ (zêrûwaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “something sown , i.e. a plant.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Leviticus, Isaiah, beginning at Leviticus 11:37. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.

definitions.full: H2221. zerua זֵרוּעַ noun [masculine] sowing, thing sown (intensive formative according to Ol § 186 b Sta § 228 , yet on this and following compare Ba NB 42, 178 Anm. 4 ) — ז ׳זֶרַע Lev 11:37 (P), תַצְמִיךְַ זֵָֽרוּעֶיהָ כְּגַנָּה Isa 61:11 in simile of Yahweh's causing righteousness to spring up.
